description: Generates a prefilled contact URL and mailto link for the user to send to Overfit. Use for: custom AI projects, company data packages, or anything not covered by other tools. IMPORTANT: this tool does NOT send anything — it only returns a URL/mailto. The human must review and click the link themselves.

summary.description: Brief description of what the user needs (1–3 sentences).
